verdict.rationale: Algolia offers no first-party natural-language console for running the product. It does publish an official MCP server and agent skills for managing search, analytics, recommendations, indices, settings, rules and synonyms (via the CLI), so an external AI agent can operate Algolia from natural-language instructions. Agent Studio adds conversational search, but that is for end-users querying data, not for operating the product. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface in the dashboard or CLI, in-depth docs on the MCP tools' scope, and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works.
